mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_product_promotion ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_quote_version_item WHERE promotion_id = #{id}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_tran WHERE promotion_id = #{id}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_product_promotion_usage WHERE promotion_id = #{id})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_product_promotion ( product_id, code, name, type, discount, rule_summary, applicable_store, customer_type, applicable_channel, inventory_scope, stackable, priority, budget_limit, used_budget, usage_limit, used_count, start_time, end_time, status, pause_reason, end_reason, void_reason, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{type}, #{discount}, #{ruleSummary}, #{applicableStore}, #{customerType}, #{applicableChannel}, #{inventoryScope}, #{stackable}, #{priority}, #{budgetLimit}, #{usedBudget}, #{usageLimit}, #{usedCount}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{pauseReason}, #{endReason}, #{voidReason}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_product_promotion SET product_id = #{productId}, code = #{code}, name = #{name}, type = #{type}, discount = #{discount}, rule_summary = #{ruleSummary}, applicable_store = #{applicableStore}, customer_type = #{customerType}, applicable_channel = #{applicableChannel}, inventory_scope = #{inventoryScope}, stackable = #{stackable}, priority = #{priority}, budget_limit = #{budgetLimit}, used_budget = #{usedBudget}, usage_limit = #{usageLimit}, used_count = #{usedCount}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, status = #{status}, pause_reason = #{pauseReason}, end_reason = #{endReason}, void_reason = #{voidReason}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE t_product_promotion SET used_budget = COALESCE(used_budget, 0) + #{discountAmount}, used_count = COALESCE(used_count, 0) + 1, status = CASE WHEN (budget_limit IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(used_budget, 0) + #{discountAmount} >= budget_limit) OR (usage_limit IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(used_count, 0) + 1 >= usage_limit) THEN 'EXHAUSTED' ELSE status END, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND start_time <= #{now} AND end_time >= #{now} AND (budget_limit IS NULL OR COALESCE(used_budget, 0) + #{discountAmount} <= budget_limit) AND (usage_limit IS NULL OR COALESCE(used_count, 0) + 1 <= usage_limit)
